text: Rick is a chemistry teacher at Barchester Academy. He requests more protective eye goggles for
the chemistry laboratories as there are not enough for all the students. The academy tells him that
they have been ordered. Until they arrive, he is told to conduct experiments in the laboratory with
small groups so that all students can be protected.
Rick is concerned that he will not be able to complete teaching his course by the end of the school
year, so he conducts some experiments with the entire class. During one of the experiments Rick
drops a container of chemicals. One student, Elaine, is seriously injured when the chemical goes
into her eye. She is not wearing any goggles as there are not enough for the whole class. She is
taken to hospital and doctors say that she will need significant treatment to make a full recovery.
Instead of storing containers of chemicals in a locked cupboard, Rick keeps them in his office.
A student enters the office without permission when Rick is not there and knocks over the
containers. The chemicals leak into an adjoining property used by Marketing Company X (MCX).
The chemicals damage the property and as a result, MCX is forced to close its business for several
days.
Advise the parties of their rights, responsibilities and potential remedies. [25]
OR
Naomi’s neighbour John is building a new house on his land. In order to install water pipes, he
is digging under Naomi’s garden without her permission. A week later she becomes aware of the
digging and asks him to stop. John says the work must be completed. John has also thrown a
number of bags of rubbish over the fence into Naomi’s garden. Naomi has asked him to remove
the rubbish, but he has refused to do so.
Naomi decides that, rather than pay to have the rubbish removed, she will burn it instead. She
starts a fire which burns for an entire afternoon and causes a lot of smoke. A strong wind blows
the smoke on to Lorayne’s property. Lorayne is forced to cancel an event which she is due to hold
in her garden that day. She has spent a substantial amount of money on food and other items for
the event. Lorayne also has an asthma attack which she believes is caused by the smoke from
Naomi’s fire.
Advise the parties of their rights, responsibilities and potential remedies. [25]
Section B
Answer two questions from this section.
Evaluate the factors considered by the court when determining whether a duty of care is owed in
negligence. [25]
It is difficult to find a defendant liable for trespass to the person because of the defences available.
Assess the validity of the statement above. [25]
Evaluate the special considerations which apply in relation to the duty owed to a child visitor under
the Occupiers’ Liability Act 1957. [25]
